fields.description: Issue dated August 4, 1928 (Vol. 8) featuring editorials and satire on Miami’s health and sunshine as civic assets, commentary on milk safety and pasteurization amid reports of tuberculosis reactors in local dairy herds, and pieces on bootlegging/prohibition enforcement. Includes local civic notes (Biscayne Boulevard nuisances, proposed post office site), theater advertising commentary, society columns, and coverage referencing the Elks convention and Al Capone-related news.
contributor: Benevolent and Protective Order of Elks
